body.name: Switching operational acceptance \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction: Derive the canonically ordered finite branch universe \(\Omega\) and \(M=|\Omega|\) from the domain, transformed-ancestry, and literal tables in \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\), and then parse the supplied finite string as switching records.  Return \(0\) for malformed input, malformed masks or identifiers, repeated records, failure of the nonempty branch masks to partition \(\Omega\), an illegal protocol, an inconsistent or out-of-catalogue label, oracle reply \(\bot\), a malformed support index, an undefined or zero-mass event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\), a source mask not extracted from the returned law handle, failed measured-ancestry typing, or an invalid concrete restriction transcript.  An empty ownership record is allowed only as a paid-protocol marker with empty label, source, and transcript fields; its protocol must be legal and its oracle reply must not be \(\bot\).  Otherwise cache one oracle reply for each distinct protocol, construct the complete deduplicated collection \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) from nonempty records, normalize \(Q\), and execute complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) from the first ancestral-set transformation through factorization and exhaustive search over every decoded source.  Return \(1\) exactly when the complete run does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\) and, for each owned \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\), the record's fixed protocol, slice, and source together with \(\tau_{\alpha}\) reproduce a successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) branch for that concrete assignment and equality type.  Every source-law or support access is an explicit \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\) query charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\).
